title: Modeling Earth-Scale Human-Like Societies with One Billion Agents

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating trust games and opinion propagation networks using LLM agents conditioned on real-world socio-demographic profiles, and comparing their decision-making (trust transfer amounts, reciprocity) and persuasion success rates across different levels of subjective social class, educational attainment, and household income.

Measuring differences in simulated trust game behaviors by stratifying and comparing the trustor send amounts between different age groups (e.g., 16-34 years old vs. 55+ years old) across varying simulation population scales.
Evaluating individual reciprocity and trust behavior in the trust game simulation by stratifying the agents' mean return amounts based on their urban versus rural residential backgrounds.
